title: Add admin flow to publish the first article so Articles page shows content

requirements.text: Add a new backend admin-only method that allows creating and publishing an article directly (without requiring a prior user submission), so the site can have its first published article and it will appear in the Articles list.
acceptanceCriteria: A new shared backend function exists that is restricted to admin callers (same permission checks as existing admin endpoints).
The method accepts the article fields needed by the existing `Story` type (at minimum: title, authorPseudonym, story/body, isAnonymous, authorName).
Calling the method results in the article being returned by `getPublishedStories()` and accessible via `getPublishedStory(title)`.
The method prevents obvious bad states (e.g., traps or returns an error when title is empty or duplicates an existing published title).

requirements.text: Update the Admin moderation UI to include a "Create & Publish Article" form that calls the new backend method, enabling an admin to add the first published article from the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: AdminModerationPage provides a clearly labeled section to create a new article with inputs for title, author pseudonym, story/body, and anonymity/author name as applicable.
Submitting the form calls the new backend admin publish method and shows a success state.
After success, the UI invalidates/refetches published-articles queries so the new article appears on `/articles` without requiring a hard refresh.
Non-admin users cannot access the creation form (they should see the existing access denied behavior).

requirements.text: Ensure the Articles page empty-state guidance reflects the presence of the admin publishing flow by clarifying that articles appear after being published (English text only).
acceptanceCriteria: When there are no published stories, the empty state message mentions that articles will appear after being published (in English).
The existing "Share Your Story" call-to-action remains available for regular users to submit stories.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing email notifications for new articles (project state indicates this is blocked).
Adding third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity.
Adding external databases or any off-chain storage.
